No pair changed after its last reading. (3) Final answer: «да» for all 189 kk pairs and all 189 en pairs. No pair got a third «нет» after the limit; the limit of decisions/0087 item 3 was not exceeded. (5) Rules over the files now: every digit group is the same in ru, kk and en in all 189 pairs (12 pairs have digits; the sign ₸ is the same in all three languages); no Cyrillic letter in any en text; every pair has ru, kk and en filled. The rest of the 40 corrected pairs are as I read them in step 16 (the texts are unchanged since: the integrity check passes); no correction changed meaning or numbers. Marked «спорно» but answered «да»: none (the answer files hold no such mark). The finding F1 of step 16 is closed. Verdict PASS for the agent readers' part; the Kazakh text still awaits a person who knows Kazakh (see the item for the native speaker).
